notes: Four isnads (the «حدثنا», «وحدثنا», «وأخبرنا», «وحدثنا» openings) carry the same story from al-Amash, so they are four routes of saying 1. The story's first person («قال: بعث إلي أبو جعفر») is al-Amash speaking, so he is the last link (rule 6).
«وزاد بعضهم على بعض في اللفظ» is a remark on wording. «وسياق الحديث لمندل» names the third route as the wording source; no route is removed.

The nested isnads «قلت: حدثني والدي، عن أبيه، عن جده» and «قلت: أخبرني أبي، عن أبيه، عن جده» are anecdotes inside the story, told by an unnamed first-person speaker: they are not stored, and needs_ruling is set (rule 11).
